clear: narrow viewport, larger type, Dock clearance, opaque material
shelf: narrow viewport, larger type, Dock clearance, opaque material
whisper: narrow viewport, larger type, Dock clearance, opaque material
Shift-Return inserts a newline; composer grows only when needed
Return simulates work and answer without losing Unicode/newline text
Outside click preserves answer/conversation
Preset changes appearance, not answer or pinned context
Reduce transparency is a true opaque fallback
Escape first closes appearance, then explicitly closes conversation
Cancel ends simulated work instead of replaying it
Whisper retains discoverable appearance controls behind pi
Hide/show work preserves the pending simulated completion
